page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical Intel Xeon 8369HB cores running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average single-core capabilities but weaker multi-core scaling. The single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall into the average tier, supported by average single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression speeds. However, multi-core performance tests, such as stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core, register in the lower percentiles. Memory bandwidth benchmarks also show weaker throughput, with large block read and write speeds measuring 31.69 GB/sec and 25.55 GB/sec respectively.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7ne.xlarge offers a dedicated hardware profile suitable for workloads that require predictable CPU allocation without the overhead of local storage or GPU accelerators. Given its average single-core performance and weaker multi-core and database benchmark results, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, text processing, and lightweight application hosting rather than intensive database operations or parallelized computing tasks.
